title: Implantable hydrogels as pioneering materials for next-generation brain–computer interfaces
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01074D, Review Article
Wasid Ullah Khan, Zhenzhen Shen, Samuel M. Mugo, Hongda Wang, Qiang Zhang
Hydrogels are emerging as promising candidates for brain–computer interfaces. This review highlights the current advancements in implantable hydrogel electrodes for neural signal recording, neuromodulation, and brain disorder treatment.
